extracted.name: Roasted Red Pepper Aioli
extracted.description: This creamy red pepper aioli made with roasted red peppers, light mayonnaise, garlic, and fresh basil will jazz up burgers, salads, or any dish.
ingredient_lines: 3 cloves garlic, peeled and halved, or more to taste
1.5 cups light mayonnaise (such as Hellmann's® Light)
1 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place roasted red peppers and basil in a food processor; pulse until coarsely chopped and combined. Add lemon juice; pulse 3 times. Scatter garlic halves over mixture; pulse to chop, 4 to 5 times. Add mayonnaise and sugar; pulse until smooth, 5 to 7 times. Season with salt and pepper.
